_comment: Row-6 negative control: the known-bad tail-starved body (RTE 2k -> 4.4k) at the SAME
verified in request-rung-pick-knownbad71k: pk-pk 6.3e-4 V << 0.1 V). N=100 per
instrument (a discriminability self-check, not a sizing claim; klt yield accepts a
shorter control list). Expected: fails the rung -> margin floor 1.0 -> yield 0.0 ->
detected. Same seed/scope contract as the campaign.
engine_version 47 is the fail-closed post-run pin; the body carries selft=0.
